g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: 04 / 25T core, auxiliary, ground and source assertions

g.desc: Title: 04 / 25T core, auxiliary, ground and source assertions

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Same net name means an electrical connection across sheets; power entry and regulators are on sheets 6-7.

g.desc: Same net name means an electrical connection across sheets; power entry and regulators are on sheets 6-7.

g.text: GTP analog power pins are on sheet 12.

g.desc: GTP analog power pins are on sheet 12.

g.text: 1.5 V I/O bank pins are on sheet 2.

g.desc: 1.5 V I/O bank pins are on sheet 2.

g.text: It is not a regulator or a proof of safe power-up.

g.desc: It is not a regulator or a proof of safe power-up.

g.text: PWR_FLAG tells the schematic checker a rail is driven.

g.desc: PWR_FLAG tells the schematic checker a rail is driven.

g.text: Ground is the common current-return connection.

g.desc: Ground is the common current-return connection.

g.text: Bank 0 also sets the JTAG reference voltage.

g.desc: Bank 0 also sets the JTAG reference voltage.

g.text: R122 is in the distributed auxiliary supply path.

g.desc: R122 is in the distributed auxiliary supply path.

g.text: U3 feeds auxiliary functions, XADC and bank 0.

g.desc: U3 feeds auxiliary functions, XADC and bank 0.

g.text: Core capacitor groups are shown on sheet 8.

g.desc: Core capacitor groups are shown on sheet 8.

g.text: R9 is in the path to the distributed core rail.

g.desc: R9 is in the path to the distributed core rail.

g.text: U2 supplies the FPGA logic and internal memory.

g.desc: U2 supplies the FPGA logic and internal memory.
